title: When Connectivity Misleads: Guiding Agentic Search with Contrastive Evidence Paths
abstract: arXiv:2610.36134v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Search agents can use cross-document graphs to discover sources through multi-hop connections and choose subsequent actions based on candidate rankings and relationships within a limited observation window. However, documents may rank highly because their numerous connections make them easier to reach, without necessarily providing more valuable evidence. Graph diffusion methods such as Personalized PageRank (PPR) aggregate propagation contributions from multiple sources, allowing highly connected distractor nodes to crowd the observation window. Flat node scores also obscure cross-document evidence trails, limiting continued exploration. We propose Contrastive Evidence Paths (CEP), which scores candidates by their strongest individual paths on a query-conditioned document graph and calibrates these scores against the same graph's background visitation distribution to mitigate structural bias. translated_title: 当连通性产生误导：利用对比证据路径引导智能体搜索
translated_abstract: 搜索智能体可以利用跨文档图通过多跳连接发现信息来源，并在有限的观察窗口内根据候选文档的排名和关系来选择后续行动。然而，某些文档之所以排名靠前，可能仅仅是因为其大量的连接使其更容易被访问到，而不一定是因为它们提供了更有价值的证据。诸如个性化 PageRank（PPR）等图扩散方法会聚合来自多个来源的传播贡献，导致高度连接的干扰节点挤占观察窗口。此外，扁平化的节点评分还会掩盖跨文档的证据链路，限制了持续探索。我们提出对比证据路径（CEP），该方法在查询条件化的文档图上根据候选文档的最强单一路径进行评分，并将这些评分与同一图的背景访问分布进行校准，以缓解结构偏差。CEP 根据校准后的分数对候选文档进行排序。
tldr: 提出对比证据路径（CEP）方法，通过在查询条件化的文档图上依据最强单一路径评分，并利用背景访问分布进行校准来消除高连通性文档带来的结构偏差，从而引导搜索智能体发现真正有价值的证据而非高度连接的干扰节点。
en_tdlr: Proposes Contrastive Evidence Paths (CEP), which scores candidates by their strongest individual paths on a query-conditioned document graph and calibrates these scores against the graph's background visitation distribution to mitigate structural bias, guiding agentic search toward genuinely valuable evidence rather than highly connected distractor documents.
